Flow.description:
RingCentral Troubleshooting Guide Phase_02
Flow to show most updated version:
1. Article search function. (Including leveraging Article to search and display the TSTree guide name) 2. Case / Contact search function. 3. Running internal troubleshooting guides and/or selected article. 4. Send email feedback. 5. Create/complete task automatically. 6. Create new case. 7. Update existing open case. 8. Send KB Request. 9. Attach used article to case automatically. 10. Attach file/s to case.
